author: reek
body: Secret entry types. A secret is a typed record with metadata, encrypted payload, and audit history.

author: reek
body: The name sort is COLLATION order, not encoding order, because this list is read by a person looking for their own vault entry. `text-collate` is the one call that gives it.

author: reek
body: It was `a.se-name < b.se-name`, which compiled and sorted by ADDRESS -- allocation order, not any order a human or a machine would recognise. The CDX2089 refusal is what surfaced it; the entries came out in whatever order they happened to be built in, and nothing said so.

author: reek
body: The other two sorts are untouched: `se-modified` and `se-accessed` are timestamps, so `>` on them is an Integer comparison and means exactly what it says.
